reasoning: This repository is a collection of production-ready starter kit templates and examples for building and deploying AI agents on Red Hat OpenShift. It contains self-contained agent templates across multiple frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Langflow, Google ADK, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, OpenCode, and A2A) organized under agents/<framework>/templates/. It also includes shared reusable components (auth, postgresql) under components/. Each agent template is independently buildable and deployable with its own Makefile, Dockerfile, Helm chart, and source code. The repo itself is not a runnable service, operator, library, or configuration — it is a curated collection of example/template projects (starter kits) meant to be cloned and customized by developers building agentic AI applications on OpenShift AI.
